rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, thing, decision, or rule that is stupid or foolish.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 zan1 hai6 ceon2

rows.note: Use this stronger, more insulting choice for an especially idiotic decision, design, or rule.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 zan1 hai6 baak6 ci1 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when stupid means irritating or troublesome rather than lacking intelligence.

example.english: This stupid advertisement is really annoying.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 zan1 hai6 faan4
